title: Project-Based Learning
description: Students work on an extended project solving an authentic problem with multiple deliverables.

steps.title: Project Launch
steps.guidance: Introduce driving question; form teams; define roles and norms.

steps.title: Research Plan
steps.guidance: Plan research tasks; identify sources; set milestones using digital tools.

steps.title: Create
steps.guidance: Develop artifacts or solutions; iterate based on feedback.

steps.title: Present
steps.guidance: Share outcomes with audience; reflect on process and learning.
